(rule!
  ;; The lone red source launches one beam immediately to its right.
  (let* ((source (first (find-color g 2))))
    ;; Slash and backslash mirrors redirect the current ray differently.
    (define (slash dr dc) (list (- 0 dc) (- 0 dr)))
    (define (backslash dr dc) (list dc dr))
    ;; Paint only traversed black cells; the first gray wall ends the trace.
    (let loop ([out g] [r (first source)] [c (+ (second source) 1)] [dr 0] [dc 1] [seen (list)] [fuel 500])
      (if (or (= fuel 0) (not (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g))) (member? (list r c dr dc) seen) (= (at out r c) 5))
          out
          (let* ((v (at out r c))
                 (nd (cond [(= v 3) (slash dr dc)]
                           [(= v 4) (backslash dr dc)]
                           [else (list dr dc)]))
                 (next-out (if (= v 0) (set-cell out r c 8) out)))
            (loop next-out (+ r (first nd)) (+ c (second nd)) (first nd) (second nd) (cons (list r c dr dc) seen) (- fuel 1)))))))
